metaTitle: P.L.A.W Padel — a training diary for padel coaches
metaDescription: Plan, log and analyze padel practices. Your own drills, clear charts, and a link to the player's fitness coach.
heroSubtitle: A training diary for padel coaches.

points.title: Your own drills
points.text: Nine focus areas, each with up to twenty drills named the way you call them on court. Nothing pre-written that you have to work around.

points.title: See where the time goes
points.text: Charts show how each player's practice time splits across focus areas and drills, and how much of it was attacking, neutral or defensive play.

points.title: One session, both players
points.text: Coaching a pair? Log the session once and copy it to the partner: same drills, same time, same notes. Then change whatever one of them didn't play.

pointsNote: Working with a fitness coach? Link the player's card and their fitness sessions show up in your calendar.
pricingSubtitle: 14 days to try it out, then it's paid. Every plan includes every feature — the only difference is how many players you keep active at once.
footerTagline: P.L.A.W Padel — a training diary for padel coaches

selfDiary.title: Are you a player? Keep your own training diary.
selfDiary.text: If your coach does not use P.L.A.W, log your practices yourself — with the drills you really do — and see where your training time goes. Share it with your parent, or link it with your fitness coach.
selfDiary.price: {monthly} a month or {yearly} a year. 14 days to try it out.
